'''Bell's Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]<ref name="Suns of Fortune" /> built by [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> It was located on the [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Gus Treta/Legends|Gus Treta]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Known for having the cheapest spiced [[Ale/Legends|ale]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], it was often frequented by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />

[[Liddy Ravora]] was a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] at Bell's Cantina but left to become an amateur [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] after realizing the value of information. After making a large amount of [[Currency/Legends|money]] as an infochant, Ravora decided to return and buy the establishment<ref name="Suns of Fortune" /> in 10 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The cantina was still operational over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later.<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bell's Cantina was mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]],<ref name="Suns of Fortune" /> released in [[2014]]<ref name="Sights">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/1/24/set-your-sights-on-corellia|text=Set Your Sights on Corellia|date=2014-01-24}}</ref> by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />
